blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — Jensen Huang apologized to Nvidia staff and said he was undergoing therapy on Tuesday, as a stock rally triggered by his surprise return as CEO faltered amid persistent doubts over the investigations he faces and the fate of the AI investment boom. “I made some terrible mistakes,” Huang told an hourlong all-hands meeting at the company’s headquarters in Santa Clara, California, The New York Times reported after reviewing a livestream of the event. He told staff that it was “not acceptable” that he had violated a code of conduct he had helped write and dismissed suggestions that he […]...
